meaning: "Homage to the Bodhisattva Guanyin", the one who hears the cries of the world. Recited for comfort and protection.
purpose: To ask for mercy and to practise it.
when: In grief, fear or illness, or every day.
note: Guanyin is the Chinese form of Avalokiteshvara, honoured across China, Taiwan and the Chinese diaspora (Kannon in Japan).
name: Namo Guan Shi Yin Pusa
